title: Favicon
brief: Favicon options for teofurlan.com, in the paper and blueprint palettes

artboards.title: Monogram T.
artboards.tradeoff: Most legible at 16 px; says the least about the work

artboards.title: Kinematic link
artboards.tradeoff: Tells the robots story; the thin ground line fades at 16 px

artboards.title: Exploded plates
artboards.tradeoff: Matches the site motif best; busiest at 16 px

artboards.title: Solid T.
artboards.tradeoff: Strongest presence in a tab bar; loses the drawing-frame character

artboards.title: T. on a drafting sheet
artboards.tradeoff: Most on brand with the site; the grid disappears below 32 px

artboards.title: T. with a joint
artboards.tradeoff: Adds a second meaning for free; the pin is only visible from 32 px up

artboards.title: T_ prompt
artboards.tradeoff: Says software and agents; less about hardware

artboards.title: Dimensioned T.
artboards.tradeoff: Most literal drawing reference; the two lines blur into noise at 16 px
